name: Zaltys the White Crow Knight
desc:
1 Illusion Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target up to 2 Spells/Traps on the field; return them to the hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect based on where it was sent from;
● Field: Set 1 "White Crow" Trap from your Deck.
● Extra Deck: Add 1 "White Crow" card from your GY to your hand.
You can only use each effect of "Zaltys the White Crow Knight" once per turn.
